game_title: Fallback: Safe Get Scout – Frozen Waterfall
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the mountaineer must hold off yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Then check safe_lookups and advance.
player_objective: Protect the pass gate from yetis in Frozen Waterfall: keep safe_lookups above zero until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 10, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
